issues.claim: All Brands Furniture, 605 New Brunswick Ave, town "Unknown (Sayreville area)"
issues.problem: Wrong town: the store's own contact page lists 605 New Brunswick Ave as Perth Amboy, NJ 08861, outside Sayreville/Parlin. It is also a four-location NJ furniture chain (Perth Amboy, Greenbrook, South Plainfield, Lawrenceville), which the brief's rules on chains discourage.
issues.fix: Remove the entry, or re-classify it as Perth Amboy and out of zone.

issues.claim: Elwir's Furniture, 224 Smith St, town "Unknown (Sayreville area)"
issues.problem: Wrong town: BBB and Loc8NearMe both place 224 Smith St in Perth Amboy, NJ 08861, not Sayreville. The entry only exists because a Google Maps search centred on Sayreville returned neighbouring-town results.
issues.fix: Remove the entry; do not rely on radius-based map searches for zone membership without confirming the municipal address.

issues.claim: Roberts Cleaners, 881 Main St, Sayreville, currently operating
issues.problem: News 12 reported (17 May 2024) that the shop closed after a car struck the building on 25 March 2024, with only Saturday 9am-1pm pickup hours for customers to collect clothing and no confirmed reopening. No source found showing it reopened.
issues.fix: Move to a 'closed/uncertain' list or drop it; replace with Sayreville Plaza Dry Cleaners & Laundromat (960 US Hwy 9), which is missing.

issues.claim: Debra Lippmann Collection, 250 Kennedy Dr, Sayreville, contemporary furniture showroom
issues.problem: No source other than the bulk Yellow Pages-derived directory could be found; no website, no directory profile, no mention in any other listing. Cannot be confirmed as an operating business in the zone.
issues.fix: Verify by phone before use, or drop; bulk-directory-only entries should not be in the verified list.

issues.problem: The motel's own directions page gives 1 Victory Plaza, South Amboy, NJ 08879. Sayreville borough records do list it among licensed motels, so zone membership is ambiguous rather than proven.
issues.fix: Keep only with a note that the postal town is South Amboy and municipal boundary is unconfirmed.

issues.claim: A Step In Time Dance Center, source_urls includes https://wrasse-cod-sczh.squarespace.com/new-page

issues.fix: Replace with https://www.asitdance.com/new-page (same contact content: 388 Washington Rd, rear entrance off Ridge Ave, 732-727-5995).

issues.claim: Numerous entries carry address "Unknown" where public data exists
issues.problem: GKB Garden Center (300 Hartle St, 732-234-3731 per the South Amboy-Sayreville Times), Saltywater Tackle (286 Washington Rd per its own contact page), ShareGood Thrift Shoppe (406 Main St, 732-679-7499), Atlantic Belt & Industrial and N&T Pawlidays Inn were all left without a street address, which weakens the record for outreach.
issues.fix: Backfill addresses from the sources already named in active_evidence.

issues.problem: Inconsistent town assignment: Paul's Toy Room (3322 Washington Rd), Avantika Creations (80 Cleveland Ave) and several Washington Rd / Bordentown Ave addresses are in the Parlin 08859 zip (some are labelled Parlin on their own sites) but are listed as Sayreville or as 'Unknown'.
issues.fix: Apply one rule for 08859 addresses and note the Sayreville/Old Bridge boundary caveat per row.

issues.claim: Thin/borderline entries: Tech Train (4000 Bordentown Ave), Furniture & Bathroom Depot (4000 Bordentown Ave), Fiona's Find (1000 US Hwy 9), Furniture to Go (95 Main St), Childrenswear Centre (2909 Washington Rd)
issues.problem: Each rests on a single stale directory; Tech Train's directory entry suggests it may have closed, and Fiona's Find is reported by Manta at 1010 US Hwy 9, Old Bridge with a different phone. These are probably-benign but unverified pipeline risk.
issues.fix: Cold-verify or demote to a 'needs verification' tier before any outreach.
